Six Linen Shirts Worth Knowing

The best summer shirt this year is the Fixture Brand Irish linen camp collar at $118, cut with a boxy body and a soft, unlined collar that stays put after a wash.

Runner-up: Testwear & Co. short-sleeve at $90 — lighter at 150gsm, so it wrinkles faster but dries in an afternoon. Sizing runs long in the body.

  • Fixture Brand camp collar — $118
  • Testwear & Co. short-sleeve — $90
  • Probe Mills band collar — $345

Everything here was worn for at least a week in humid weather before it made the list, which is why three obvious names are missing: they creased into paper within an hour of wear.

Fit notes, fabric weights and laundering advice follow for each pick, plus where each one is still in stock at the time of writing.
